authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner dāru piece of wood includes Khowar dar timber/firewood and the wider dār-/daru firewood family. The survey’s Khowar and southeastern daru/daṛu wood terms are compared with that first-branch wood noun, retaining their vowel and r/ṛ transcription. The homophonous medicine/liquor loan and separately listed dāruka extension are not substituted.
